words.note: 當 anchor 指某個人、制度或事物提供可靠支持，使別人能依靠時，可用 support。它比 anchor 少了『固定／穩住』的畫面感，但在日常語境很自然。
words.example: Her family remained her strongest support during the difficult year.
words.exampleZh: 在艱難的一年裡，她的家人一直是她最強的支柱。

exercises.original: During the crisis, her older sister was an anchor she could rely on every day.
exercises.zh: 危機期間，她的姐姐每天都是她可以依靠的支柱。
exercises.upgrade: support · 支柱；支持；依靠

options.explanation: burden = 負擔。和可靠依靠的正面作用相反。
support = 支柱／支持。could rely on every day 是直接線索。
competitor = 競爭者。不是提供依靠的人。
observer = 旁觀者。沒有提供支持的作用。
deadline = 截止日期。無關。
reward = 獎勵。不是人際支柱。

exercises.original: The community centre became an anchor for families who needed practical help after the flood.
exercises.zh: 水災後，社區中心成為需要實際幫助家庭的重要支援。
exercises.upgrade: support · 支柱；支持；依靠

options.explanation: meeting place only = 只是聚會場所。題目強調 practical help，不只是聚會。
symbol = 象徵。可能有象徵意義，但不是實際支援。
shelter only = 只有避難所。範圍太窄。
burden = 負擔。相反。
support = 支援。families needed practical help，正是 support 的功能。
decoration = 裝飾。無關。

exercises.original: Good childcare can be an anchor for parents trying to remain in full-time work.
exercises.zh: 良好的托兒服務可以成為希望維持全職工作的父母的重要支援。
exercises.upgrade: support · 支柱；支持；依靠

options.explanation: support = 支援。helps parents remain in work，是最自然改寫。
luxury = 奢侈品。不是核心。
barrier = 障礙。和幫助留在職場相反。
expense only = 只是開支。沒有表達支援作用。
risk = 風險。無關。
delay = 延誤。無關。

words.note: 當 anchor 指某個團隊、家庭、組織或制度中最可靠、最不可或缺的支柱時，可用 mainstay。它比一般 support 更強，表示長期而核心的依靠。
words.example: She has been a mainstay of the department for twenty years.
words.exampleZh: 二十年來，她一直是部門的中流砥柱。

exercises.original: For two decades, Maria has been an anchor of the nursing team, training new staff and covering difficult shifts.
exercises.zh: 二十年來，Maria 一直是護理團隊的中流砥柱，培訓新人並承擔艱難更份。
exercises.upgrade: mainstay · 中流砥柱；主要支柱

options.explanation: visitor = 訪客。和二十年核心角色不符。
junior = 初級成員。和 training new staff 不符。
backup only = 只是後備。角色太弱。
mainstay = 中流砥柱。two decades + trains others + takes difficult shifts 是典型。
critic = 批評者。不是核心支柱。
outsider = 外部人士。相反。

exercises.original: The small farm has been an anchor of the family business for three generations.
exercises.zh: 這個小農場三代以來一直是家族生意的主要支柱。
exercises.upgrade: mainstay · 中流砥柱；主要支柱

options.explanation: side project = 副項目。和三代核心角色不符。
temporary asset = 臨時資產。和 three generations 衝突。
mainstay = 主要支柱。long-term core support 是最精準。
experiment = 試驗。不是長期支柱。
hobby = 興趣。不是主要業務。
expense = 開支。無關。

exercises.original: The veteran defender remained an anchor of the team even as younger players came through.
exercises.zh: 即使年輕球員不斷加入，那名老將後衛仍是球隊中流砥柱。
exercises.upgrade: mainstay · 中流砥柱；主要支柱

options.explanation: rookie = 新秀。和 veteran 不符。
substitute only = 只是後備球員。角色太弱。
spectator = 觀眾。不是球隊成員。
referee = 裁判。不是球隊支柱。
opponent = 對手。相反。
mainstay = 中流砥柱。veteran + remained central despite younger players 是決定性線索。

words.meaning: 穩定點；穩住局面的支點
words.note: 當 anchor 強調某個位置、制度或因素使整個系統不致偏移、失控或漂移時，可用 stabilising point。這是直接呼應 anchor『穩定作用』的解釋性近義詞。
words.example: The central hub acts as a stabilising point for the whole structure.
words.exampleZh: 中央樞紐成為整個結構的穩定點。

exercises.original: The fixed central joint acts as an anchor that keeps the rotating frame from drifting sideways.
exercises.zh: 固定的中央接點作為穩定點，防止旋轉框架向側面偏移。
exercises.upgrade: stabilising point · 穩定點；穩住局面的支點

options.explanation: cover = 蓋子。無關。
decoration = 裝飾。沒有穩定功能。
moving part = 活動部件。原句明確說 fixed。
weak spot = 弱點。相反。
stabilising point = 穩定點。fixed joint + prevents sideways drift 是直接定義。
counterweight only = 只是配重。配重是一種特定機制，不等於此固定支點。

exercises.original: The exchange-rate policy was designed to provide an anchor that reduced sudden swings in the market.
exercises.zh: 匯率政策旨在提供一個穩定點，以減少市場突然波動。
exercises.upgrade: stabilising point · 穩定點；穩住局面的支點

options.explanation: target only = 只是目標。目標不一定能穩定波動。
stabilising point = 穩定點。reduced sudden swings 是最直接線索。
forecast = 預測。不是穩定機制。
profit source = 利潤來源。無關。
warning = 警告。無關。
deadline = 截止日期。無關。

exercises.original: The heavy base provides an anchor for the sculpture so that strong winds do not shift it.
exercises.zh: 沉重底座為雕塑提供穩定點，避免強風吹動它。
exercises.upgrade: stabilising point · 穩定點；穩住局面的支點

options.explanation: stabilising point = 穩定點。heavy base + prevents shifting 是典型。
surface finish = 表面處理。不是穩定功能。
display area = 展示區。無關。
label = 標籤。無關。
decoration = 裝飾。不是結構作用。
transport handle = 搬運把手。無關。

words.note: 當 anchor 指某個人、制度或因素持續抑制混亂、波動或不確定性時，可用 stabilising force。它比 stabilising point 更偏動態影響。
words.example: Her calm leadership became a stabilising force during the crisis.
words.exampleZh: 危機期間，她沉着的領導成為穩定力量。

exercises.original: The experienced manager became an anchor during the merger, keeping the team calm and focused.
exercises.zh: 合併期間，那位有經驗的經理成為穩定力量，讓團隊保持冷靜和專注。
exercises.upgrade: stabilising force · 穩定力量；穩定因素

options.explanation: distraction = 分心因素。和 calm and focused 相反。
rival = 對手。無關。
stabilising force = 穩定力量。keeps team calm and focused 是直接線索。
expense = 開支。無關。
outsider = 外人。不是核心影響。
risk = 風險。相反。

exercises.original: A reliable legal system can act as an anchor for investment during periods of political uncertainty.
exercises.zh: 在政治不確定時期，可靠的法律制度可成為投資的穩定因素。
exercises.upgrade: stabilising force · 穩定力量；穩定因素

options.explanation: barrier = 障礙。可能阻礙投資，和穩定作用不同。
competitor = 競爭者。無關。
cost = 成本。無關。
rumour = 傳聞。通常會增加不確定性。
deadline = 截止日期。無關。
stabilising force = 穩定因素。legal reliability during uncertainty 是典型。

exercises.original: The central bank hoped the new policy would serve as an anchor during a period of rapid price changes.
exercises.zh: 中央銀行希望新政策在價格急速變動期間成為穩定力量。
exercises.upgrade: stabilising force · 穩定力量；穩定因素

options.explanation: stimulus only = 只有刺激措施。刺激不一定降低波動。
forecast = 預測。不是穩定力量。
warning = 警告。無關。
stabilising force = 穩定力量。rapid price changes 需要穩定因素。
tax = 稅。只是政策工具類型。
reward = 獎勵。無關。

words.meaning: 穩定人心的影響；使人鎮定的力量
words.note: 當 anchor 指某個人對團隊、家庭或個人在壓力下有鎮定、穩住情緒的作用時，可用 steadying influence。它特別適合人際和心理語境。
words.example: His calm presence was a steadying influence on the younger players.
words.exampleZh: 他沉着的存在對年輕球員起了穩定作用。

exercises.original: Her calm voice was an anchor for the children during the storm.
exercises.zh: 暴風雨期間，她平靜的聲音是孩子們的安定力量。
exercises.upgrade: steadying influence · 穩定人心的影響；使人鎮定的力量

options.explanation: threat = 威脅。和 calm voice 的安定作用相反。
steadying influence = 穩定作用。calm voice during a storm 明確是情緒上的鎮定。
noise = 噪音。忽略其安撫功能。
instruction only = 只是指令。原句重點不是命令。
distraction = 分心因素。不是穩定。
surprise = 驚喜／意外。無關。

exercises.original: The captain was an anchor in the dressing room after the team lost three matches in a row.
exercises.zh: 球隊連敗三場後，隊長在更衣室成為穩定人心的力量。
exercises.upgrade: steadying influence · 穩定人心的影響；使人鎮定的力量

options.explanation: steadying influence = 穩定作用。after repeated losses + dressing room morale 是典型。
rival = 對手。不是隊內角色。
critic = 批評者。未必能穩定人心。
spectator = 觀眾。不是隊內影響。
risk = 風險。相反。
problem = 問題。相反。

exercises.original: His humour became an anchor for the family while they waited for news from the hospital.
exercises.zh: 家人在等候醫院消息時，他的幽默成為穩定情緒的力量。
exercises.upgrade: steadying influence · 穩定人心的影響；使人鎮定的力量

options.explanation: argument = 爭論。相反。
cause of delay = 延誤原因。無關。
warning = 警告。無關。
expense = 開支。無關。
steadying influence = 穩定人心的影響。humour helps family cope with anxious waiting。
rumour = 傳聞。通常增加焦慮。

words.meaning: 令人踏實的力量；使人保持穩定與現實感的因素
words.note: 當 anchor 指某個人、習慣或價值使人保持踏實、冷靜、不被壓力或成功沖昏時，可用 grounding force。語氣較現代、常見於心理與生活方式語境。
words.example: Daily exercise became a grounding force during a stressful year.
words.exampleZh: 在壓力很大的一年裡，每日運動成為令人踏實的力量。

exercises.original: Even after becoming famous, her family remained an anchor that kept her connected to ordinary life.
exercises.zh: 即使成名後，她的家人仍是讓她保持貼近日常生活的踏實力量。
exercises.upgrade: grounding force · 令人踏實的力量；使人保持穩定與現實感的因素

options.explanation: publicity = 宣傳／曝光。通常會增加名氣，不是讓人踏實。
pressure = 壓力。相反。
career boost = 職涯推動。不是保持現實感。
audience = 觀眾。無關。
reward = 獎勵。無關。
grounding force = 踏實力量。kept her connected to ordinary life 是直接線索。

exercises.original: His morning routine became an anchor during months of uncertainty and constant change.
exercises.zh: 在數月的不確定與不斷變化中，他的早晨習慣成為令人踏實的力量。
exercises.upgrade: grounding force · 令人踏實的力量；使人保持穩定與現實感的因素

options.explanation: distraction = 分心。不是穩定感來源。
deadline = 截止日期。可能增加壓力。
grounding force = 令人踏實的力量。routine provides familiarity amid uncertainty。
risk = 風險。相反。
expense = 開支。無關。
challenge = 挑戰。不是安定因素。

exercises.original: The garden was an anchor for her after retirement, giving structure to each day.
exercises.zh: 退休後，花園成為她生活中的踏實力量，令每天都有規律。
exercises.upgrade: grounding force · 令人踏實的力量；使人保持穩定與現實感的因素

options.explanation: hobby only = 只是興趣。忽略了 giving structure to each day 的安定功能。
expense = 開支。無關。
burden = 負擔。相反。
grounding force = 踏實力量。gives daily structure after retirement 是典型。
deadline = 截止日期。無關。
competition = 競爭。無關。

words.note: 當 anchor 指繩索、纜線、結構或運動系統中的固定位置，可用 fixed point。它強調不移動、可供其他部分連接或定位。
words.example: The cable is attached to a fixed point in the wall.
words.exampleZh: 纜線連接到牆上的固定點。

exercises.original: The safety rope must be attached to a secure anchor before the climber moves higher.
exercises.zh: 攀爬者往上前，安全繩必須先連到可靠的固定點。
exercises.upgrade: fixed point · 固定點；固定支點

options.explanation: fixed point = 固定點。safety rope needs a secure non-moving attachment。
loose loop = 鬆圈。不能提供可靠安全固定。
moving pulley = 活動滑輪。重點不是固定支點。
marker = 標記。沒有承重作用。
decoration = 裝飾。無關。
handle = 把手。通常不是結構固定點。

exercises.original: The cable uses the concrete column as an anchor so the line stays in position.
exercises.zh: 纜線以混凝土柱作固定點，使線保持位置。
exercises.upgrade: fixed point · 固定點；固定支點

options.explanation: support beam only = 只有支撐樑。柱子在此功能是纜線的固定位置。
joint movement = 接點運動。相反。
measurement = 測量值。無關。
cover = 蓋。無關。
fixed point = 固定點。line stays in position 是最直接線索。
weight = 重量。不是 attachment location。

exercises.original: The map pin serves as an anchor while the rest of the diagram rotates around it.
exercises.zh: 其餘圖形繞着地圖釘旋轉時，地圖釘充當固定點。
exercises.upgrade: fixed point · 固定點；固定支點

options.explanation: moving edge = 活動邊緣。和固定中心相反。
fixed point = 固定點。everything rotates around it，是典型幾何／結構語境。
label = 標籤。無關。
colour code = 色碼。無關。
scale = 比例尺。不是旋轉支點。
caption = 圖說。無關。

words.note: 當 anchor 指後續判斷、談判、估算或思考所依據的起始基準時，可用 reference point。它常見於決策、價格、心理學和分析語境。
words.example: The first estimate became a reference point for later negotiations.
words.exampleZh: 第一個估算成為之後談判的參照點。

exercises.original: The opening price acted as an anchor for later negotiations, even after new information appeared.
exercises.zh: 即使出現新資訊，開價仍成為之後談判的參照點。
exercises.upgrade: reference point · 參照點；基準

options.explanation: final result = 最終結果。開價是起始基準，不是結果。
deadline = 截止日期。無關。
expense = 開支。無關。
reference point = 參照點。later negotiations continue to refer back to the opening price。
warning = 警告。無關。
discount = 折扣。不是基準概念。

exercises.original: The original forecast became an anchor against which later projections were compared.
exercises.zh: 原始預測成為之後各項預測的比較基準。
exercises.upgrade: reference point · 參照點；基準

options.explanation: reward = 獎勵。無關。
mistake = 錯誤。原句沒有說原始預測錯。
deadline = 截止日期。無關。
cost = 成本。無關。
rumour = 傳聞。無關。
reference point = 參照點。against which later projections were compared 是定義性線索。

exercises.original: The first number mentioned in the discussion became an anchor for everyone's later estimates.
exercises.zh: 討論中最先提到的數字成為所有人後續估算的參照點。
exercises.upgrade: reference point · 參照點；基準

options.explanation: random error = 隨機錯誤。原句強調後續估算受到它影響。
final answer = 最終答案。它只是起始數字。
reference point = 參照點。later estimates are judged relative to it。
deadline = 截止日期。無關。
warning = 警告。無關。
average = 平均值。原句沒有說是平均。

words.note: 當 anchor 比喻指價值、原則、信任或制度為其他事物提供穩固根基時，可用 foundation。它比 anchor 更強調『建立在其上』。
words.example: Trust is the foundation of a strong partnership.
words.exampleZh: 信任是穩固合作關係的根基。

exercises.original: Shared values became the anchor of the partnership, guiding every major decision.
exercises.zh: 共同價值成為合作關係的根基，指引每個重大決定。
exercises.upgrade: foundation · 基礎；根基

options.explanation: decoration = 裝飾。不是核心原則。
argument = 爭論。不是根基。
reward = 獎勵。無關。
deadline = 截止日期。無關。
foundation = 根基。shared values guide every major decision，表示整段關係建立於其上。
exception = 例外。無關。

exercises.original: Scientific evidence should be the anchor of any public-health recommendation.
exercises.zh: 科學證據應成為任何公共衞生建議的基礎。
exercises.upgrade: foundation · 基礎；根基

options.explanation: foundation = 基礎。recommendation should be built on evidence。
opinion only = 只有意見。證據導向並非純意見。
guess = 猜測。和 scientific evidence 相反。
headline = 標題。無關。
rumour = 傳聞。相反。
exception = 例外。無關。

exercises.original: Trust served as the anchor of the long-term agreement between the two organisations.
exercises.zh: 信任是兩個組織長期協議的根基。
exercises.upgrade: foundation · 基礎；根基

options.explanation: risk = 風險。不是建立協議的基礎。
foundation = 根基。trust underpins a long-term agreement，是固定自然比喻。
cost = 成本。無關。
deadline = 截止日期。無關。
rivalry = 競爭。和 trust 相反。
publicity = 宣傳。無關。

words.meaning: 錨具；用來固定船隻或物體的裝置
words.note: 當 anchor 指實際的船錨或用來抓住海床、固定船隻的實體裝置時，anchoring device 是最安全的解釋性改寫。英語中並沒有一個在所有情況下都比 anchor 更自然的單字同義詞，因此不硬塞不準確詞。
words.example: The vessel carries a heavy anchoring device for use in deep water.
words.exampleZh: 這艘船備有一個可在深水使用的重型錨具。

exercises.original: The crew lowered the anchor to hold the boat in place overnight.
exercises.zh: 船員放下船錨，讓船整晚保持原位。
exercises.upgrade: anchoring device · 錨具；用來固定船隻或物體的裝置

options.explanation: rope only = 只有繩索。繩可連接錨，但不是抓住海床的核心裝置。
buoy = 浮標。用來標示或繫泊，不等於船錨本身。
rudder = 舵。用來控制方向，不是固定位置。
ballast = 壓艙物。用來增加穩定性，不是固定船位。
dock = 碼頭。是岸邊設施，不會由船員『放下』。
anchoring device = 錨具。lowered to hold the boat in place 是直接定義。

exercises.original: The ship's anchor caught firmly on the seabed and stopped the vessel from drifting.
exercises.zh: 船錨牢牢抓住海床，令船隻停止漂移。
exercises.upgrade: anchoring device · 錨具；用來固定船隻或物體的裝置

options.explanation: rudder = 舵。控制航向，不抓海床。
mooring buoy = 繫泊浮標。是外部繫泊點，不是船自身的錨。
ballast = 壓艙物。增加穩定，但不固定船位。
anchoring device = 錨具。caught on seabed + stopped drifting 是完整功能。
propeller = 螺旋槳。推進船隻。
chain only = 只有錨鏈。錨鏈是系統一部分，不是抓住海床的裝置本身。

exercises.original: Before the storm arrived, the captain checked that the anchor was secure and ready to use.
exercises.zh: 暴風雨到來前，船長檢查錨具是否牢固並可使用。
exercises.upgrade: anchoring device · 錨具；用來固定船隻或物體的裝置

options.explanation: rudder = 舵。控制方向。
sail = 帆。用於借風推進。
anchoring device = 錨具。secure and ready to hold the vessel 是最精準。
engine = 引擎。提供動力。
buoy = 浮標。不是船上的錨具。
ballast only = 只是壓艙物。不能替代固定船位的 anchor。

falseSynonyms.zh: 繫泊；繫泊設備／位置不等於一般的 anchor mooring 是把船固定在某處的整套安排、繫泊位置或動作；anchor 可以是其中一種固定方式，但 mooring 不等於船錨本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A mooring is an arrangement or place for securing a vessel; an anchor is a specific anchoring device.

falseSynonyms.zh: 浮標不等於一般的 anchor buoy 漂浮在水面，可用來標示位置或作繫泊點；它不是抓住海床的船錨。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A buoy floats and marks or supports a mooring; it is not an anchor.

falseSynonyms.zh: 壓艙物；壓載不等於一般的 anchor ballast 透過增加重量與降低重心來提高船隻穩定性，但不把船固定在某個海床位置。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Ballast stabilizes a vessel; an anchor holds it in place.

falseSynonyms.zh: 舵不等於一般的 anchor rudder 用來改變船隻方向；anchor 用來固定位置、防止漂移。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A rudder steers; an anchor holds.

falseSynonyms.zh: 重量；重物不等於一般的 anchor 錨通常很重，但單純的 weight 並不一定具備抓住海床、固定位置的設計。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An anchor may be heavy, but weight alone does not make something an anchor.

falseSynonyms.zh: 鏈；錨鏈不等於一般的 anchor chain 常把船與錨連接，但不是錨本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The chain connects the vessel to the anchor.

falseSynonyms.zh: 主持人不等於一般的 anchor 在新聞／電視語境中 anchor 可表示主播或主持人，但這是另一詞義。本課聚焦『支柱／穩定點／船錨』，所以不把 host 列入主同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Host matches the broadcasting sense of anchor, not the senses covered in this lesson.
